caption: An empty glass bottle is pushed neck-first under the water in a sink, and water flows in while a stream of bubbles escapes from the neck.

sa.check: An empty glass bottle is pushed neck-first under the water in a sink.
A stream of bubbles escapes from the neck.
The push under comes first and the filling follows.

pc.expect: Water rises inside the bottle while air leaves, and it fills only as fast as the air escapes.
pc.fail: It fills instantly; or stays empty under water; or empties again.

pc.expect: The bubbles climb to the surface.
pc.fail: They sink; or hang; or go sideways.

pc.expect: The water is liquid and the bubbles wobble.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or the bubbles are solid; or the water beads.

pc.expect: The bottle stays where it is held.
pc.fail: It floats away; or jumps; or spins.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bottle and the sink stay the same.
pc.fail: The bottle changes colour; or the sink changes; or the kitchen rearranges.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
